response.overview: Through the act of writing, Loyah, a woman in her late twenties, begins retracing the paths of her childhood. What starts as a journey of self-discovery quickly transforms into a confrontation with long-suppressed memories. The film delicately unravels the fragile threads of memory, identity, and family.
response.tagline: The past is never as far away as we imagine.
response.title: LOYAH: A Fleeting Melody

release_dates.note: Loyah: A Fleeting Melody is a 2023 student graduation film by Akansha Gogoi, Jahanabi Moran, Khreisanyii Solo, and Shuktara Goswami from St. Anthony’s College, Shillong. The film had its official premiere at the 2023 Kelvin Cinema Festival.
